note:
Malcolm rejected the copper-cylinder band and supplied four peptide references. Of the three concepts generated from them he chose P1 (ribbon render) and P3 (microscopy field). P1 goes on the homepage band. Of the two candidates he allowed for P1 (1 or 4), candidate 4 is used: it holds the larger unbroken black area on the left, which is where this band sets its headline and button.

P3 candidate 3 is his other pick and is not placed here — the natural home is the research-page banners, where the peptide device earns its keep. Flagged for his direction.
